oracle.activityBoundary: every callActivity argument and return value crosses oracle/lib/boundary.js, as the Durable Task extension serialises them; OutboundCourtRegister therefore receives the ORCHESTRATOR's hearing, not the copy SetCourtRegister mutated

contract.basis: the document the legacy produced satisfies the frozen add-court-register contract; progression accepts it, so the port must produce the same document

inputContract.basis: cpp-platform-core-domain/criminal-court-public-model/src/main/resources/json/schema/global/defendant.json associatedPersons.minItems = 1; an empty array violates it
inputContract.note: The producer cannot emit this. The recording is what the legacy DOES with the input, and is evidence about robustness; it is NOT a parity obligation. The port's behaviour here is a design decision — the message-contract gate dead-letters it.

evidence: CONSTRUCTED — a base hearing's array is rewritten by this harness

provenance.subscriptionsOrigin: cpp-context-azure-legalaidagency/azure-functions/durable-functions/NowsVariantsSubscriptions/test/subscriptions.json (five court-register entries, verbatim, including the one entry in the whole capture that covers court house B01LY00)
provenance.note: A child who survives every filter to the outbound document: youth-flagged, a youth date of birth, a middle name, both ethnicity descriptions, two defendantCaseJudicialResults so postHearingCustodyStatus reaches a real value, an associated defence organisation, a two-entry defendantAttendance with the youth's record SECOND (defect C8), and a prosecuting-authority court application.
provenance.operatorRationale: The transform decides "produce a register / produce nothing" on array length in four places (CourtRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:26 and :50, OutboundCourtRegister/index.js:17 and :22), and the frozen OUTPUT contract puts `minItems: 1` on every list it declares — so an emptied input array is very often the shortest route to a document progression refuses. MOST TARGETS ARE SCHEMA_INVALID on the input axis: only courtApplications, courtApplicationCases and their offences declare minItems 0. Each variant records which it is.
